_comment: ADR-003 §5 rule 1 (A 2026-11-03): the modules tools/fabric/state_writes.py admits although they resolve the per-agent state directory and write a file, or read AGENT_FABRIC_STATE_DIR themselves. Each value says why: the record's clause that admits it, 'not state:' and what it writes instead, or 'gap (jNNN):' and the job that closes it. An entry admits the whole module, a later write in it included, so a gap's entry leaves when its job lands. Lock files on their terms (os.open, O_CREAT, no O_TRUNC, 0o600) are never findings and need no entry.
